items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: This guy at Columbia, Quincy was over there.

ctx.x: So one day, this was about two or three weeks later, Cannonball comes over the hotel and he says, "Listen, Klook, I don't know how to tell you this." I said,
"Look, Cannon, you can tell me anything." He said, "This guy at Columbia, Quincy was over there." Bob -- the A&R man. You know.
